positions.title: Staff Software Engineer in Tools & Infrastructure
positions.description:
Enhancing your web experience, one ad at a time!

Staff Software Engineer in Tools & Infrastructure, leading a Measurement & Attribution productivity team  in Ads & Commerce, building test infrastructure, release pipelines, monitoring solutions, and product tools to increase developer productivity. Working mostly with C#, Java, and Python, with some experience using AngularJS and Dart.

Working mostly with C#, Java, and Python, with some experience using AngularJS and Dart.
